What happens to my USDC when I create a: What happens to my USDC when I create a pledge?
Your USDC is transferred to a secure vau: Your USDC is safely stored in a vault on Solana. Complete your goal 100% and you get every penny back — no fees!
What if I only partially complete my goa: What if I only partially complete my goal?
You get back a proportional amount minus: You'll get back a proportional amount minus a small 1% fee. For example, stake $10 and complete 50% — you get $4.95 back. The rest supports the community!
What happens if I forget to report?: What happens if I forget to report?
After your deadline plus a 24-hour grace: No worries! After your deadline plus a 24-hour grace period, we'll automatically settle your pledge based on the tasks you checked off. Just keep checking those boxes daily!
What are daily tasks vs one-time tasks?: What are daily tasks vs one-time tasks?
Daily tasks repeat on your chosen schedu: Daily tasks repeat on your chosen schedule — every day, weekdays, weekends, or custom days. One-time tasks are goals you complete once during your pledge. Mix both types to build the perfect plan!
Can I edit a pledge after creating it?: Can I edit a pledge after creating it?
Yes, you can edit your pledge name, task: Yes! You can freely edit your pledge name, tasks, and schedule before the deadline — no penalty at all. Just note that the stake amount and deadline are locked on-chain once created.
After your deadline passes, you have a 2: After your deadline, you get a 24-hour grace period to self-report your completion. This ensures the most accurate result! After that, we'll automatically settle based on the tasks you checked off.
Forfeited funds are split between the Pl: Forfeited funds are split between the Pledge treasury and a charity wallet. 30% goes to a non-profit organization — so even if you fall short, your pledge still does some good!
Pledge is open-source software — all cod: Pledge is fully open-source — anyone can review the code! However, the smart contracts haven't been formally audited yet. We recommend starting with small amounts. Never stake more than you're comfortable with!
Pledge uses Mobile Wallet Adapter (MWA): Pledge works with any Solana wallet that supports Mobile Wallet Adapter (MWA). Phantom and Solflare on Android both work great! Just make sure your wallet is installed and set up.
How can I contact the team?: How can I contact the team?
You can reach us through our Telegram co: We'd love to hear from you! Join our Telegram community or follow us on X (Twitter). You can find the links in Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy in Settings.
onboarding_welcome_body: Set a goal, pledge your USDC, and earn it back by following through. Pledge keeps you accountable.
onboarding_how_body:
1. Create a goal with tasks and a deadline
2. Pledge your USDC as commitment
3. Track your progress daily
4. Report your completion and get your tokens back
onboarding_tasks_body: Daily tasks repeat on your chosen schedule — every day, weekdays, weekends, or custom days. One-time tasks are marked with a "Not daily" button and are goals you complete once during your pledge period. Mix both types in a single pledge.
onboarding_rules_body:
Complete 100% → get your full pledge back, zero fees.
Partial completion → proportional refund minus a small 1% fee.
0% completion → pledge is forfeited.

30% of all forfeited funds go to a non-profit organization. So your loss still helps someone in need.

Details of the non-profit organization we work with can be found in the FAQ page in Settings.
onboarding_grace_body: After your deadline, you have 24 hours to self-report your completion for the most accurate result. If you don't report in time, we'll calculate it automatically based on the tasks you checked off.
onboarding_ready_body: Create your first pledge and start achieving your goals. You can revisit this guide anytime in Settings.
